text.en: Clients frequently praise the front desk team and 24/7 boarding attendants for sending frequent photo updates and looking after dogs with genuine affection. However, sentiment is mixed, as one traveller reported booking confusion when an unneutered dog was refused entry upon arrival.

Pet owners describe the indoor boarding suites and playrooms on 14th Street as immaculate, safe, and modern, valuing the crate-free setting. Nonetheless, sentiment is mixed because one reviewer raised concerns regarding safety in the immediate downtown neighborhood and street vagrancy.

Reviewers note that companion dogs thoroughly enjoy group play sessions, returning home tired and contented after exercising with other pets. Owners appreciate that pets are supervised constantly rather than crated, allowing dogs to build social confidence in a structured play environment.

q.en: Is an attendant present on-site during overnight boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight that overnight attendants remain present 24/7 to monitor boarding pets and provide comfort.

q.en: Do owners receive photo updates throughout the day?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note receiving regular photo and video messages showing their dogs at play.

q.en: Can unneutered adult dogs board at this location?

a.en: Reviewers advise verifying intake requirements directly, as unneutered pets may not be accepted for group boarding.

q.en: Are dogs crated during standard daycare hours?

a.en: No, the facility operates a cage-free day camp environment where dogs interact in supervised group play yards.
